scores.evidence: Four can-do objectives with matching Bloom verbs; each has at least 2 graded items at apply level or above (o1 q1/q5, o2 q2/q6, o3 q3/q7, o4 q4/q8/q10/q9). Caveat: o3's MoSCoW sorting is graded only as picking Musts.
Concrete 3-sentence scenario followed by the ungraded predict q0 leading into o2.
ch0/ch1 recalled and terms defined before use, but the q4 explanation names Claude Code, which ch0/ch1 have not introduced.
Non-quiz JP body about 3,620 characters against the 1,200–2,400 budget; estMinutes 30 against 8–20. Section 2-3 alone is about 880 characters plus a 6-step example, a diagram, a prompt and a quiz.
Full 6-step worked example with reasons and expects, but no faded example, and the plan stores a monthly budget that no Must lets the user enter.
Inline check in every content section with feedback on every wrong option; q1 mirrors the sentence just read and q5 distractors repeat the hook's.
The four brief misconceptions are corrected in body and feedback, but several distractors are strawmen (q6 d, q7 a, q8 c, q9 c).
Screen-flow diagram with takeaway caption and JP/EN alt; two comparison tables; no decorative images.
Authentic transfer task with expects, checklist and model answer, but only three steps have a second hint level and the model answer lacks an event-creation Must.
Summary after the exam, reflection prompt, next steps, 6 flashcards and askTutor suggestions.
Key claims cited and matching sources; q4 d infers beyond the cited source; budget-entry gap in the plan.
Consistent です・ます, warm, no banned phrases; summary points use plain form by course convention; q4 explanation's Claude Code aside lacks context.
Every learner-facing string has jp and en including diagram labels and alt; natural EN.

mustFix.issue: Body about 3,620 JP characters against a 2,400 cap and estMinutes 30 against 8–20, deferred for three rounds.
mustFix.fix: Move the practice section (practice-task, practice-steps, practice-prompt, practice-tip, practice-checklist) into a new draft content/courses/vibe-coding/drafts/vibe-ch2-practice.lesson.json with its own short hook and objectives o3/o4, keeping the ids; leave course.json to the owner and point to it from summary-next. Cut at least 150 more JP characters from 2-3 so the body is ≤ 2,400 and set estMinutes ≤ 20. If the owner rejects the split, record the waiver in the brief.

mustFix.issue: The worked plan stores a monthly budget but no Must, step or screen lets the user enter it; the club-app model answer starts at an event list with no Must to create an event.
mustFix.fix: Fold budget entry into an existing Must (「今月の予算の設定と残り金額の表示」) across s5-b2, ex-moscow.expect, s2-b3.expect and practice-prompt var hints; relabel s2-b4 node B accordingly (EN to match). For the club app add 「イベントの作成」 as a Must in practice-prompt.expect and mention it in the flow.

summary: Strong design (concrete hook, one idea per segment, inline checks, reasoned worked example, exam with 2+ transfer items per objective). Two blockers: the lesson is about 50% over the length budget (split the practice or record an owner waiver), and the worked plan and model answer omit a Must they depend on (budget entry, event creation).
